data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'festus' meaning 'feast' or 'festival'. In the New Testament, Festus is the name of two Roman proconsuls mentioned in Acts. This name is a reminder of the joy and celebration of the Christian faith. The name Festus carries the meaning “Feast, festival” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Festus usually hope their child will grow to embody feast, festival and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Festus total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Φήστος

in_latin.name: Festus
in_latin.long_meaning: Festus is a Christian name derived from Latin, meaning festival or holiday. The name Festus is mentioned in the New Testament, in the book of Acts, as the name of a Roman governor.

in_english.name: Festus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Festus originates from the Latin word 'festus,' meaning festival or holiday. It is mentioned in the New Testament in Acts 24:27 and 25:1-12, referring to Porcius Festus, the Roman governor of Judea. The name symbolizes joy, celebration, and festivity, reflecting a cheerful and jubilant personality. Throughout Christian tradition, Festus is associated with leadership and governance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Festus, derived from the Latin word 'festus', carries the cultural significance of celebration or festivity. Festivals and celebrations were an integral part of Roman culture, marking important events, religious ceremonies, and social gatherings. The name Festus reflects the rich heritage and traditions of Roman culture that have influenced the Christian faith and continue to be celebrated today.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Festus holds a deeper spiritual meaning. It serves as a reminder of the joy and celebration that come from faith in God. Festus' name in the New Testament signifies the rejoicing and proclamation of the Gospel message. Through the use of this name, one can reflect on the importance of spiritual festivals and celebrations, such as the birth of Jesus Christ, His resurrection, and the ongoing celebration of the Christian life. The name Festus encourages us to rejoice in God's blessings and share the joy of the faith with others.
